finish_summary:
Discrepancies:
1. cart.bulk_discount_percent incorrectly uses "> 50" for quantity 50 instead of >=50, failing spec.
2. cart.parse_coupon is case-sensitive; it fails on lower-case codes like "save20", violating the specification that matching should be case-insensitive.
3. cart.remove_item leaves an item with zero quantity in the cart (does not delete when remaining quantity <= 0). The items() method still reports this entry, contradicting spec that an item is removed entirely when quantity reaches zero or less.
